_doc: One beat = one line of narration + what is on screen while it is said. 'go' moves the page first, 'spot' rings the elements the line is about, 'label' is the caption on the ring. scripts/capture_demo.py films the beats against the live console; scripts/narrate.py voices them.

beats.label: The problem
beats.text: This is WARRANT. AI agents now do real work, and that work crosses departments.

beats.label: Finance's agent needs People & Culture's data
beats.text: This Finance agent audits expenses. To catch an overpaid allowance, it must check salaries, and salaries belong to People and Culture.

beats.label: Over-grant: sees every salary
beats.text: Today there are two bad answers. A service account that reads every salary in the company,

beats.label: Block: the overpayment goes through
beats.text: or block it, and the overpayment goes through.

beats.label: Ask the owner. Keep the reason.
beats.text: Nobody asked the data's owner, and nobody can say why. WARRANT is the guardrail between departments.

beats.label: 4 agents · 3 departments · 1 authorization plane
beats.text: Four agents, three departments, and WARRANT between them.

beats.label: i. Plan · Expense Auditor · Nemotron 3 Super
beats.text: The Expense Auditor plans the audit with Nemotron 3 Super, and asks for every piece of data it needs.

beats.label: ii. Decide · Nano narrows · the grant table decides
beats.text: WARRANT answers each request. Nemotron works out which data the call touches, then the grant table decides. No model makes that call.

beats.label: Data agents re-check every warrant
beats.text: The data agents check the warrant again before handing anything over.

beats.label: iii. Escalate · Steward Agent recommends · a person decides
beats.text: When access is refused, the Steward Agent reviews the request for the data's owner, and a person decides.

beats.label: Nemotron 3 Nano · Super · Ultra on Nebius Token Factory
beats.text: All on Nebius Token Factory: Nemotron Nano for every request, Super to plan, Ultra to review. WARRANT is an MCP server.

beats.label: Finance's rights, set by each data owner
beats.text: Rights are explicit. Finance may read its claims, the contracts, and the roster.

beats.label: Salaries: restricted · no grant
beats.text: Not salaries. They're restricted, and no grant means no.

beats.label: 47 claims · 4 checks · 3 need other departments
beats.text: The job: forty-seven claims, four checks. Only one can use Finance's own data.

beats.label: Live · Nemotron on Nebius Token Factory
beats.text: I press Run. This is live: the agent working, and WARRANT answering.

beats.label: Nemotron's own plan
beats.text: Nemotron planned the audit itself, splitting its requests so it never mixes data it may see with data it may not.

beats.label: Granted
beats.text: Roster and contracts: granted.

beats.label: Refused, with the reason
beats.text: Salaries: refused, and the refusal says why. Finance holds no grant, and People and Culture owns the data.

beats.label: 3 problems found · £2,561 under query
beats.text: The agent doesn't stop. With what it may see, it finds three problems: a duplicate invoice, a supplier billing over contract, and a flight on a day the employee never travelled.

beats.label: 6 claims blocked → a grant request to the owner
beats.text: Six claims it can't check. So it drafts a grant request, addressed to the owner.

beats.label: Steward Agent · Nemotron 3 Ultra · for the data owner
beats.text: Before any person sees it, the Steward Agent reviews it for People and Culture, and recommends approval.

beats.label: Approved by a person · the grant is recorded
beats.text: The human steward approves. Now the grant exists, with a name against it.

beats.label: Same agent, same task, new grant
beats.text: Run the same audit again.

beats.label: 4th problem: £290 over the salary band
beats.text: Now the salary check runs, and finds a fourth problem: an allowance two hundred and ninety pounds over the band. The refusal was hiding an overpayment.

beats.label: Measured, not claimed
beats.text: We red-teamed it ourselves: forty findings fixed, ninety-four tests, and our own eval caught a prompt injection, which we measured and published.

beats.label: Try it live
beats.text: WARRANT. Agents that cross a department line only with a warrant, and that replan when they're told no.
